question: Does current M3 systematically under-evaluate escape/front-running horses, and is a structural probability correction justified?
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; exact M3 validation universe

protocol.history: strictly prior starts only; up to 5 starts for position features

feature_definitions.hist_front_mean: Mean normalized first-available-corner frontness over up to 5 strictly prior starts: (field_size - corner_position)/(field_size - 1). Higher means more forward.
feature_definitions.lead_rate5: Fraction of up to 5 strictly prior starts in which first available corner position was 1.
feature_definitions.hist_cov5: min(number of strictly prior starts used, 5)/5.
feature_definitions.escape_candidate: lead_rate5>=0.20 with at least 2 strictly prior starts.
feature_definitions.strong_escape: lead_rate5>=0.40 with at least 2 strictly prior starts.
feature_definitions.forward_type: hist_front_mean>=0.70 with at least 2 strictly prior starts.
feature_definitions.back_type: hist_front_mean<0.45 with at least 2 strictly prior starts.

front_only.type: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, liblinear) + race common-logit projection sum=3

front_plus_lead.type: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, liblinear) + race common-logit projection sum=3

interpretation.escape_specific: NOT_ESTABLISHED. lead_rate5 alone does not give a reliable OOS improvement and escape-only residual CIs cross zero.
interpretation.front_position_bias: ESTABLISHED_FOR_STRUCTURAL_M3. Higher prior frontness is underweighted by current M3, while deep-closing types are overpredicted. A pre-race frontness correction improves top-3 logloss in both 2025 and 2026 OOS.
interpretation.market: Closing market probability already absorbs most of this information. Adding frontness/lead to market+M3 does not yield a reliable OOS improvement.
interpretation.recommended_name: 前方位置補正, not 逃げ残り補正
interpretation.recommended_scope: Structural M3 probability layer only. Do not convert this into a betting/value signal and do not alter core M3 rank without separate ranking validation.
